summary: Not accepted. The site contains the 0.2.5 updates and recorded successful deployment, but review acceptance does not bind the separate site source. Published documentation also cites superseded live receipts and contains an invalid copyable Rust example.

findings.description: The unchanged-source check excludes this chunk's actual implementation: fingerprint() ignores .local/docs-site-worktree and excludes docs/reviews/, including the deployment receipts. The 113-command phase check report contains no site check, and chunk acceptance validates only the root fingerprint and scope path strings. Changing the site or replacing its deployment receipts therefore does not invalidate an accepted docs-site review or prevent phase advancement.
findings.required_fix: Bind the docs worktree commit and source contents, deployment workflow, and receipt hashes to the preserved review/check evidence. Validate those bindings before and after review and during phase advancement. Add regressions proving site-only changes and replaced or mismatched deployment evidence invalidate acceptance.

findings.description: The current qualification section and MCP tags section cite attempt 01, whose runtime fingerprint is 7071e8d8454e0edf10f75bcb07063e90ba75c35959f36ee178fd3ab1b401d8b6. The refreshed release receipts are attempt 02 with fingerprint a495f826dc8a6360105a21bc3fdac1a152424fad37a7f074289e31ef689bf5a6. The gateway guide also cites MCP attempt 01, while the 'current receipt reference' still points to an older commit. Readers cannot follow these links to the evidence qualifying the released runtime.
findings.required_fix: Update both guides to the attempt-02 receipts and release-specific qualification/live-evidence ledgers. Keep earlier receipts explicitly historical, and check that current documentation references match the release's bound runtime evidence.

findings.description: The new example includes rustdoc-only '# fn build()' and '# let _' lines. Docusaurus renders these prefixes literally; inspection of the generated HTML confirms they are present in the code block. Copying the example produces invalid Rust syntax.
findings.required_fix: Use ordinary Rust function syntax without rustdoc hiding prefixes. Verify the exact copyable example against scm-sdk 0.2.5 with the gateway feature enabled.
